title: Iran-Oman deal could cement Tehran’s control of Hormuz — NYT
text:
Iran-Oman deal could cement Tehran’s control of Hormuz — NYT"

"Under the proposed accord:"

"▪️Gulf-bound ships would use an Iran-controlled channel"
"▪️Departing ships would use a channel near Oman"
"▪️'Service fees' would be split equally between Tehran and Muscat"

"⚡️This has not been confirmed by Iran
